headline: Trump Targets $6.2 Billion Offshore Wind Project in Energy Policy Shift
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has targeted a $6.2 billion offshore wind development near completion, pushing to expand fossil fuel extraction and redirect focus away from renewable energy.
why: Federal policy shifts on offshore energy leases create major capital risk for multinational utility and clean-energy infrastructure investors.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy
impacts.why: Federal efforts to halt projects and revoke leases heighten policy risk and threaten returns on capital-intensive offshore installations.
